name: Abiezer
overview: Abiezer was a male member of the tribe of Manasseh, identified uniquely as the son of Hammolecheth. His mention in Scripture is brief, with no additional notes or detailed narrative about his life or deeds.
namesAndTitles: The name Abiezer means '[my] father is help,' reflecting a Hebrew origin. This proper name is not indicated as being given directly by God but carries a meaningful expression of reliance on paternal assistance.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records that Abiezer was the son of Hammolecheth, as noted in 1 Chronicles 7:18. Beyond this paternal relationship, no other family connections are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Abiezer's significance in the biblical record is primarily genealogical, serving to identify a lineage within the tribe of Manasseh. His mention helps preserve the heritage and tribal affiliations important to Israel's history, though no further narrative or theological role is attributed to him in Scripture.
